## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* early-Qīng re-compilation by **Jiànyuè Dútǐ** 見月讀體 (1601–1679) of Sìmíng Zhīlǐ's earlier Northern-Sòng *Qiānshǒu yǎn dàbēixīn zhòu xíngfǎ* ([KR6d0200](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0200), T1950). The work preserves Zhīlǐ's foundational Avalokiteśvara *dhāraṇī* liturgy in early-Qīng recension, providing the standard institutional apparatus for the Bǎohuáshān *Vinaya*-school's continued use of the practice.

**Abstract**

The two-stage editorial production — Zhīlǐ's Sòng original compilation and Dútǐ's early-Qīng re-compilation — demonstrates the continuous institutional vitality of the Avalokiteśvara *dhāraṇī* devotional tradition through more than six centuries of East-Asian Buddhist history.

The dating bracket (996–1679) covers the entire textual development from Zhīlǐ's original through Dútǐ's re-compilation.
